name: Antipaladin Spells (3pp)
body:
1st-Level Antipaladin Spells (Third Party Publishers)
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Ail		As magic weapon, but the weapon gains ability to inflict flare (as the spell) on targets that are hit, rather than gain an enhancement bonus .	SGG:110SV
2nd-Level Antipaladin Spells (Third Party Publishers)
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Abyssal Body		Touched creature gains DR 5/good.	BoM: SS1
Anarchic Body		Touched creature gains DR 5/lawful.	BoM: SS1
Dark Confinement		Subjects are unable to leave dimly lit areas.	AG:PS
Ox Mind		Touched Creature gains resistance bonus to Will saves.	BoM: SS1
Shadow Wound		Strike at a creature by attacking its elongated shadow.	AG:PS
Vile Mark		As scorching ray but you only ever receive 1 bolt and the target is affected as by a brand spell.	SGG:110SV
3rd-Level Antipaladin Spells (Third Party Publishers)
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Backhand		As inflict light wounds, but a target that fails its Fortitude saving throw is also knocked prone .	SGG:110SV
Summon Dwarven Armor		Willing creature is surrounded by magical full plate armor	BoM: SS1
Night Terror		Subjects become terrified of darkness.	AG:PS
4th-Level Antipaladin Spells (Third Party Publishers)
Spell Name	Comp.	Description	Source
Banish Light		Creates total darkness within 30 ft., negates light and fire magic.	AG:PS
Void Field		Pitch-black field negates all sensory input.	AG:PS
